integrity.claim_proof: Self-contained analytic reduction using degree, hypocycloid geometry, Gaussian radial integrals, residues, and uniform asymptotic expansion.
integrity.numerical_checks: 64 corroborative assertions in CHECKER.py; not an exhaustive proof.
integrity.review_provenance: Self-review only; no independent examination or validation.

scientific_limitations: Only a monic analytic term and a single Gaussian anti-analytic linear coefficient, with an independent Gaussian target, are treated.
Critical transition points are excluded from the distinct-zero count.
The large-degree correction is uniform on compact positive coupling intervals, not uniformly at zero or infinity.
Absolute historical priority is not certified, notably against reformulations of deterministic caustic and complex-parameter results.
title: Gaussian harmonic trinomials: a one-crossing valence law and its logarithmic large-degree correction
